newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba, Cisco to tie up in Internet technology.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba, Cisco to tie up in Internet technology.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Monday that it and Cisco Systems Inc of the United States would cooperate in setting up common standards for next-generation multi-layer switching technology for the Internet.

They aim to establish open global standards for the switching technology, and expect an Internet rules body called the Internet Engineering Task Force to adopt them as international standards, the two companies said in a statement.

The new technology is expected to improve the performance of the Internet and Intranet -- internal communication networks for corporations which use the Internet -- by ensuring quick handling of data, Toshiba and Cisco said.
They did not elaborate on the details of the standards they would establish.
